preferred_if_native_write_fails: B: normal contactF/T through existing verified DEFINE_SDOF_PROPERTIES load path

candidates.name: Alternative Fluent-supported6DOF collision/state-update API
candidates.support: UNKNOWN: installed public example supports Overwrite. No separately documented public6DOF motion setter located.
candidates.limitation: Internal declarations do not establish a supported plugin state-update contract. Calling the internal integrator could advance/recompute motion twice; no experiment performed.
candidates.action: Seek version-specific supported API guidance before implementation

candidates.name: Normal contact force/torque through existing SDOF load properties
candidates.support: DOCUMENTED: external global/body forces and moments in DEFINE_SDOF_PROPERTIES; existing magnetic COM F/T path empirically verified
candidates.principle: Let the native6DOF integrator update motion. Evaluate a normal contact force and COM torque with one consistent event/time law.
required_validation: Impulse integral over absolute time, independent of number of property calls
candidates.limitation: F=J/dt alone is not a validated collision model. Several property evaluations per timestep must not accumulate the force multiple times. Detection latency and integration can change achieved impulse.

candidates.name: Calibrated short-range penalty contact force
candidates.support: Load path available; stiffness/damping/model accuracy unvalidated
candidates.limitation: Adds contact constitutive parameters and timestep/stiffness constraints; requires new authorization and calibration. No penalty or repulsion added.

candidates.name: External rigid-body integrator coupled to Fluent
candidates.support: Coupling architecture not audited as a supported replacement in this frozen case
candidates.limitation: Largest architecture change; requires force/torque exchange, native overset pose synchronization, stability and double-integration prevention. No prescribed CG_MOTION substitution.
